column1: # The black-box V4 leg parity census (ADR-090).
# hook  currency0  currency1  fee  tick_spacing  pool_id
# The three hooks with the most mainnet V4 pools (5,737 / 5,114 / 2,240 pools)
# plus a seeded draw of 20 hooks from the 4,387 amount-modifying hooks
# (hooks & 0xCC != 0) that hold at least one recorded liquidity position, out of
# the 10,628 amount-modifying hooks in the registration DB.

#     JOIN erc20_tokens t1 ON t1.id = p.currency1_id
#    ORDER BY (SELECT count(*) FROM managed_pool_liquidity_positions m
#    LIMIT 8   -- the top hooks; 2 per long-tail hook
# with the long-tail hook indices drawn from a splitmix64 stream seeded
